one_liner: DataForSEO offers a broad REST API for SEO data with Basic auth. Signup is free and includes a $1 trial credit plus a free sandbox. An official MCP server exists.
auth_notes: The REST API uses HTTP Basic with an API login and password. OAuth 2.0 is documented only for the MCP server, not the REST API, so Basic stays primary.
access_notes: Free signup gives API credentials, a $1 trial credit that never expires, and a free sandbox with dummy data. Real usage is pay-as-you-go with a $50 minimum top-up and no subscription.
blocker_notes: No blocker. Free signup, a sandbox and trial credit are enough to build and test.
